eps.ov: Well-coiffed alien hunter Dandy and his robot sidekick search for a cat-like alien in the premiere of this anime series following the group's search for undiscovered species across the galaxy.

eps.t: The Search for the Phantom Space Ramen, Baby
eps.ov: An alien chef known for making phantom ramen might be the answer to the gang's money problems.

eps.t: Occasionally Even the Deceiver Is Deceived, Baby
eps.ov: Dandy's ship crashes on an unknown planet, where he meets a beautiful young woman. But she is not what she appears.

eps.t: Sometimes You Can't Live with Dying, Baby
eps.ov: Meow is bitten by an alien and turns into a brain-eating zombie.

eps.t: A Merry Companion Is a Wagon in Space, Baby
eps.ov: Dandy embarks on a road trip with an alien girl who traps his consciousness in the body of a stuffed penguin.

eps.t: The War of the Undies and Vests, Baby
eps.ov: Dandy and Meow get stuck on a distant planet and trapped in an endless battle over wearing underwear.

eps.t: A Race in Space Is Dangerous, Baby
eps.ov: Hoping to impress the ladies at Boobies, the Aloha Oe crew enter a galactic grand prix against its glamorous reigning champion Prince, his state-of-the-art robot Z, and his rat-like alien lawyer Squeak.
Meow gets jealous when Dandy finds a dog on a deserted planet, but when the pooch turns out to be carrying tiny alien stowaways, the crew might never see Boobies again!

eps.t: Plants Are Living Things, Too, Baby
eps.ov: Dandy’s search for a mysterious alien rumored to be living on a distant planet brings him into contact with a race of giant, super intelligent, walking, talking plants!
Dandy and the gang get stuck in a time loop.
Dandy is lured to the library planet with the promise of free food and booze.

eps.t: Nobody Knows the Chameleon Alien, Baby
eps.ov: Dandy catches an alien that can mimic any creature's appearance. It starts copying Dandy, and then suffers an identity crisis.

eps.t: Even Vacuum Cleaners Fall in Love, Baby
eps.ov: QT falls in love with a coffeemaker, pitting abandoned appliances against their humans.
